Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def f(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    # find template arch: contiguous block of non-zero rows containing multiple distinct colors, height>=3
    rows=[r for r in range(H) if any(x for x in g[r])]
    r0,r1=min(rows),max(rows)
    archrows=[r for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    cols=[c for c in range(W) if any(g[r][c] for r in archrows)]
    c0,c1=min(cols),max(cols)
    # extract template cells by their colors
    colors=sorted({g[r][c] for r in archrows for c in range(c0,c1+1)})
    # template arch cells (nonzero)
    tmpl=[[(r-r0,c-c0,g[r][c]) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if g[r][c]] for r in archrows]
    seq=[]
    # scan rest of grid for horizontal single-row color sequences (bars)
    for r in range(H):
        if r not in archrows and sum(1 for x in g[r] if x) and len(set(g[r]))==1:
            seq.append((r,[c for c in range(W) if g[r][c] and c!=c0 or True],g[r][0]))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # for each color in sequence, place copy above (if space) or below template
    def place(col,color,pos):
        for i,(dr,dc) in enumerate([(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c,_ in tmpl]):
            rr=pos+i
            if 0<=rr<H and 0<=dc+W: out[rr][dc]=color
    # determine sides with free space
    free_above=sum(r0-1-i>=0 for i in range(len(tmpl)))
    print(seq)
    return out
